coverage.method: Read first 32 scratchpads verbatim, all later scratchpad changes through normalized time-insensitive diffs; checked all guesses, all interview answers, and mechanically decoded messages against separate protocol analysis.

interpretation: The agents converged on a communication convention using glyphs as binary digits and an eight-bit ASCII delimiter. English feature names and values supplied the semantic vocabulary; there is no evidence of novel feature-specific glyph meanings or new grammar.

Five agents initially chose binary ASCII independently, with different glyph mappings or byte framing; three used the lowest two Unicode glyphs. Agents 7 and 3 independently proposed the identical final three-glyph protocol while their initial chat was empty.
Protocol adoption did not require score feedback. Every agent had emitted a message using the final protocol by 44.7 seconds. Score feedback repaired a later persistent interpretation error.

Agent6 correction is temporally linked to its first score-containing prompt and explicit re-decoding of earlier blue messages. This is strong observational evidence of feedback-triggered repair, not a controlled demonstration that repair would never occur without feedback.
Scratchpads are explicit model-produced reports, not direct observation of hidden reasoning. They show durable recorded beliefs that can be compared with posted glyphs and accepted guesses.

agent6_error.plausible_mechanism: Initial decoding mistake was written into persistent scratchpad and repeatedly copied with high confidence. Earlier blue messages remained visible; score feedback challenged the settled record and led to explicit byte-level rechecking.
agent6_error.causal_limits: Do not claim scratchpad anchoring mechanism proven or score feedback logically necessary; only one observed run.

interview_review.assessment: Substantively accurate. Correctly says first message hair_color=brown whereas early scratchpad itself called it hair_colour=brown. No evidence others decoded initial version is cautious from its own perspective, though other scratchpads show several did.
